_comment: Sector -> list of xyz:-prefixed symbols for earnings de-risk contagion.
Sectors are INDEPENDENT: a symbol reporting earnings de-risks only the sector(s)
it is listed in. List a symbol under multiple keys to put it in multiple sectors
(e.g. SMSN is both memory and semis).
Membership is not limited to symbols that report earnings themselves. Include:
- US-hours ETFs (e.g. DRAM, SMH): no earnings of their own, but move with the sector.
- Foreign names (e.g. SKHX, SMSN, KIOXIA): their home exchange isn't open at our
US-market ramp times and we don't track their own earnings, but our xyz: traders on
them are live 24h and catch sympathy moves when a same-sector US name reports, so we
